Entries: Sampling requires various efforts or investments. This table defines those actions based on author experience and then estimates how they vary among different sampling approaches. Using the common currency of technician hours makes it possible to add up various efforts into a single number.
By obtaining a single value for effort, it is possible to plot return on investment for different methods.
US Geological Survey, Western Ecological Research Center, c/o Marine Science Institute, University of California
